title: Infini FPS BOOST
description: A lightweight optimization modpack that boosts FPS, reduces stutter, and ensures smooth Minecraft performance even on low-end PCs.
body:
Infini FPS BOOSTED

Infini FPS BOOSTED is a lightweight, high performance Minecraft modpack designed to deliver maximum FPS, smooth gameplay, and minimal lag, especially on low end and mid range systems.

---

Features

* Significant FPS boost optimized for low end PCs
* Reduced stuttering and lag spikes
* Faster chunk loading
* Optimized memory RAM usage
* Improved game responsiveness lower input lag

---

Included Optimizations

This modpack uses a carefully selected set of performance focused mods, including:

* Sodium – Rendering engine optimization
* Lithium – Game logic optimization
* Starlight – Lighting engine improvements
* FerriteCore – Memory usage reduction
* Entity Culling – Smart rendering optimization
* And other small tweaks for maximum performance

---

Recommended Specs

* CPU Intel i3 or i5 or equivalent
* RAM 8GB or higher 4GB minimum
* GPU Integrated graphics supported Intel HD series works

---

Best Use Cases

* Low end PCs and laptops
* PvP Bedwars Skywars
* Survival SMP gameplay
* Recording gameplay with better performance

---

Recommended Settings

* Render Distance 6 to 10 chunks
* Graphics Fast
* Smooth Lighting OFF
* VSync OFF

---

Notes

* Designed for performance over visuals
* Compatible with most Fabric based setups
* Works great for both casual and competitive gameplay

---

Support

If you like this modpack, consider supporting by following or sharing it.
Feedback and suggestions are always welcome

---

Made by Infini Gamer
